title: Understanding the Population of Interest
text: The population of interest refers to the entire group of individuals or instances about whom the study is concerned. In this case, think about who Rachel is focusing on for her study.

title: Who Receives the BayPass?
text: Consider who is receiving the BayPass transit card in Rachel's study. This group is crucial for understanding the population of interest.
